run_extraction_pipeline: run a multi-GPU feature extraction pipeline using a pretrained neural network model on an image dataset
configure_trainer_with_args: configure a Trainer with architecture, weights, batch size, and dataset path via command-line arguments
setup_cluster_config: setup a ClusterConfig with NCCL distributed backend and a UUID-based init file for multi-GPU coordination
create_trainer_config: create a TrainerConfig with data folder, architecture, weight path, input size, and GPU rank settings
execute_trainer_call: execute the Trainer call to extract features and print validation accuracy on the primary GPU rank
